name: Academia Ecuatoriana de la Lengua — Diccionario académico de ecuatorianismos
use: Primary Ecuador lexicon reference. Use to identify regional senses and regional labels; paraphrase entries and write original examples rather than copying definitions or example sentences.

name: Ministerio de Educación — Diccionario académico de ecuatorianismos
use: Searchable entry pages for Ecuadorian words, including guagua, guambra, yapa, yapar, ñañería, and atatay. Use as a source of leads and confirm the current entry before adding it.

name: AEL — Corpus del Habla del Ecuador (CORPHA)
use: Check authentic contexts, region, date, source type, and repeated occurrences. Each app entry should record an actual corpus query before claiming corpus evidence; none of the new entries in this initial update has a logged CORPHA query.

name: ASALE — Diccionario de americanismos
use: Compare country-tagged meanings and register across Spanish varieties. Useful comparisons here include bacán, guagua, atatay, guambra, canguil, and yapa.

name: Carlos Joaquín Córdova — El habla del Ecuador
use: Bibliographic lead for deeper Ecuadorian vocabulary history and usage. Consult the work directly; do not reproduce its entries.

name: Hablemos Ecuatoriano, de chulla vida a YOLO
use: A contemporary reference to explore colloquial phrases. Treat it as a discovery source; create original app explanations and examples.

name: Ecuadorian phraseology study — coastal and Manabí expressions
use: Research lead for fixed expressions and cultural context, with emphasis on the Ecuadorian coast and Manabí. Use the paper as scholarship, not as a pool of text to copy.

name: Ecuadorian Spanish and Quichua contact — phraseology study
use: Research lead on Quichua words in Ecuadorian Spanish phraseological units. Check linguistic and community context before adding etymology or cultural claims.

name: Mitad — Spanish Dictionary for Ecuador
use: The project owner supplied MITAD sunrise and sunset vocabulary and example structures. Use as a cited lead; reuse permissions for its dictionary content are not established.

name: AEL — Fichero de correcciones, precisiones y adendas a la marcación diatópica
use: Use to catch omissions or inaccurate Ecuador geographic labels in broader RAE/ASALE repertories before assigning an Ecuador-specific or regional tag.

name: AEL — Method notes for the Diccionario académico del habla del Ecuador
use: Documents AEL's evidence workflow: CORPHA first, then additional Ecuadorian sources when corpus evidence is insufficient. Use as a model for Habla Ecuador verification.

name: Cuenca air-quality research — Sellers & Espinoza (2017)
use: Two credited Spanish/English abstract sentence pairs power local research-reference retrieval. CC BY 3.0; English is editorially adapted, with subject-expert review pending. Source metadata and license evidence are in data/research-source-manifest.json.

name: Sangay · fish diversity — 2017 research
use: Two credited abstract sentence pairs for local research translation memory. Article-specific CC BY 3.0; English adapted; subject-expert review pending. See data/research-source-manifest.json for provenance.

name: Morona Santiago · bat specimen — 2017 research
use: Two credited abstract sentence pairs for local research translation memory. Article-specific CC BY 3.0; English adapted; subject-expert review pending. See data/research-source-manifest.json for provenance.

name: El Colegio de México — Diccionario del español de México (DEM)
use: Corpus-based reference for Mexican meanings, grammar, register and multiword expressions.
limits: Presentation verified. Check the actual sense before marking an entry corroborated. CC BY-NC-ND 4.0: registering this link does not authorize a bulk import or adapted definitions.
importStatus: Reference registered; no complete dictionary or corpus imported.

name: El Colegio de México — Corpus oral del español de México (COEM)
